entities.summary: Mire De Juan Chatman is an American former professional basketball player. Standing at 1.87 m, he played at the point guard position. He is a Texas Pan American University alumnus who as an American became the all-time leading scorer as for Americans and the all-time leader in performance index rating of any player as to the history of Eurocup Basketball.
